#+title: habshe-emacs — yasnippet
#+author: A. Shehab (habshehabshe)

Yasnippet, globally active, with snippets sourced exclusively from
this repository's tracked =snippets/= directory. The default
snippet directories (the bundled collection and =~/.emacs.d/snippets=)
are replaced, not appended — one place of truth for snippet content.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp :tangle "../lisp/my-yasnippet.el"
  ;;; my-yasnippet.el --- GENERATED from org/yasnippet.org — do not edit -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
  ;;; Commentary: Yasnippet, global, snippets from our repo only.

  (defgroup my-yasnippet nil
    "Snippet expansion for my Emacs configuration.")

  ;; Soft require: if the install pass could not run (e.g. no network
  ;; on first boot), init survives without snippet expansion.
  (when (require 'yasnippet nil t)
    ;; Our directory only — replaces the bundled collection and the
    ;; default ~/.emacs.d/snippets.
    (setopt yas-snippet-dirs
            (list (expand-file-name "snippets" user-emacs-directory)))
    (yas-global-mode 1))

  (provide 'my-yasnippet)
#+end_src
